'''Alexandre Dufresne There Is Still Good In Him''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alexandre Dufresne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11159">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11159 There Is Still Good In Him], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 15 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11159/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11159/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018105333/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11159/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Alexandre Dufresne]]
